dataset_summary.plain_description: Inputs for a property investment valuation case, including per-property purchase prices, holding periods, terminal values, rental revenue terms, operating cost terms (fixed schedules or percentages of revenue), an optional overhaul scenario for one property, and a generated monthly period calendar used for cashflow modeling and discounting.
dataset_summary.notes: Property variant 4a (no overhaul) and 4b (with overhaul) are mutually exclusive options for the same underlying property. Indexation uses a base date of 2018-01-01 and steps annually; discounting uses a valuation base date of 2017-12-31 with discount rates stored as decimal fractions.
